speed_method: interleaved child CPU time, min-of-N, with a null control (on/on) run through the same harness; the box carried load average 11-14 from sibling agents throughout, which is why wall-clock is not used

sweep.note: the single changed function is the witness; an earlier revision without the offset-0 condition changed 2, the second being a MIPS o32 $gp save slot mistaken for a printf argument

probe_flip.why: the behavioural acceptance is met -- scanf recovers its destination and all three printf calls their %s argument -- but the filed acceptance string is the literal 'scanf("%d",&v3)' and the fix renumbers the locals (two stores it un-deletes are declared before the w0 temporary), so the destination prints as &v2. The probe no longer passes, the acceptance string does not match.

decisions: The filed hypothesis (AArch64 variadic-call argument recovery or stack-address propagation is losing live arguments) is WRONG about the location. check_input_trial_use scores the [sp+0] trial ACTIVE; ParamListStandard::fillinMap deactivates it again. Recorded per docs/re-pipeline.md's instruction that the tester's diagnosis is not binding.
The four observations the brief grouped as one cluster are three distinct root causes, and one of them is not a call-site bug at all. See analysis.md's scope table.
Reactivating the stack trial in place was rejected: forceInactiveChain's trailing promotion loop would fabricate x1-x7 as six invented register arguments. The section has to be cut instead.

The offset-0 condition on the cut is not a fit to the counter-example but a statement about what the field means: MIPS o32's stack pentry offset 16 is, in mips32be.cspec's own comment, 'backup storage space for register params'; x86-64's 8 and i386's 4 are the pushed return address; Win64's 32 are the home area. An ABI that reserves nothing in front of its first stack argument is one that can pass the whole variadic tail there.

ARM32 AAPCS (stack pentry at offset 0, variadic arguments DO fill r0-r3 first) is the residual over-recovery shape the guard does not exclude. Four ARM binaries in the sweep changed nothing; the risk is named in use_when as the flip-back condition rather than hidden.
